summary: Tested the newly wired Art Restoration feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 19/19 pytest assertions passed — auth gating, seeded user tier, upload/list/fetch scan, Gemini-backed condition report (completed with condition_score, damage_assessment, recommendations, estimated_restoration_cost), restoration simulation (cleaning) with simulation_id, techniques_applied and ai_confidence, and pricing tiers (pro_collector=$1499, collectors_advisory=$4999 — both increased vs prior defaults). Frontend: ProtectedRoute redirects unauth users to '/'; after setting session_token cookie, /dashboard shows Art Restoration Studio CTA card (data-testid='restoration-cta-card') and nav-restoration link; CTA navigates to /restoration; all 4 tabs (tab-upload/tab-scans/tab-reports/tab-simulations) render; Take Photo input has accept='image/*' capture='environment'; upload-btn present.
passed_tests: Backend: All /api/restoration/* endpoints return 401 for unauthenticated requests
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with bearer token returns seeded user (test-restoration@emaira.art, tier=collectors_advisory)
Backend: GET /api/payments/tiers returns 200 with pro_collector and collectors_advisory present
Backend: pro_collector price is $1499 (>= 1499 — increased)
Backend: collectors_advisory price is $4999 (>= 4999 — increased)
Backend: POST /api/restoration/upload-scan accepts base64 JPEG and returns image_id + image_url
Backend: GET /api/restoration/scans lists user's scans with image_url; excludes raw data
Backend: GET /api/restoration/scan/{image_id} streams image bytes (content-type image/*)
Backend: GET /api/restoration/scan/{unknown} returns 404
Backend: POST /api/restoration/condition-report generates completed report with condition_score, damage_count, recommendations_count
Backend: GET /api/restoration/condition-report/{id} returns damage_assessment[], recommendations[], estimated_restoration_cost, image_url
Backend: GET /api/restoration/condition-reports lists the generated report
Backend: POST /api/restoration/simulate-restoration (type='cleaning') returns simulation_id, restoration_type, ai_confidence, techniques_applied[]
Backend: GET /api/restoration/simulations and /api/restoration/simulation/{id} return expected shape with original_image_url and status
Frontend: Unauthenticated /restoration redirects to / (ProtectedRoute working)
Frontend: /dashboard shows restoration-cta-card and nav-restoration after cookie-based session auth
Frontend: Clicking restoration-cta-card navigates to /restoration
Frontend: /restoration renders tab-upload/tab-scans/tab-reports/tab-simulations; all tabs switch
Frontend: Take Photo input has accept='image/*' and capture='environment' (mobile camera)
Frontend: upload-btn present on Upload Scan tab
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5270 lines — strongly recommend splitting restoration_router (~440 lines) into its own module (e.g., /app/backend/routers/restoration.py) for maintainability.

restoration.upload-scan accepts arbitrary base64 without MIME sniffing or max-size cap; a malicious client could post huge payloads. Consider enforcing a hard max (e.g., 50MB) and validating via Pillow before persisting.

Condition report fallback values use hardcoded defaults (condition_score=70, overall_condition='fair') when Gemini JSON parsing fails — this could mislead users. Consider exposing a 'low_confidence' flag.
Subscription endpoint path is /api/payments/tiers but review_request mentioned /api/subscriptions/tiers — main agent should confirm the frontend & docs use the correct path.
ArtRestoration.js is ~930 lines in a single file; consider breaking into tab-level sub-components for maintainability.
test_credentials: Bearer TEST_SESSION_TOKEN_RESTORATION_2026 → user test-restoration@emaira.art, tier=collectors_advisory. Seeded via /app/backend/seed_test_session.py.
seed_data_creation: Test data created during the run (prefixed TEST_): one artwork_scan, one condition_report (completed), one restoration_simulation (cleaning). These remain in MongoDB for potential reuse by subsequent test runs. To clean up, the main agent can delete collections artwork_scans/condition_reports/restoration_simulations documents where user_id matches the seeded test user (email=test-restoration@emaira.art).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Art Restoration feature fully wired and working end-to-end. Backend endpoints at /api/restoration/* (note: subscription tiers served at /api/payments/tiers, not /api/subscriptions/tiers). Gemini calls take ~10-30s; use generous timeouts (>=90s). Seeded test user is tier=collectors_advisory so tier-gated endpoints are accessible. For Playwright tests, set cookie session_token=TEST_SESSION_TOKEN_RESTORATION_2026 on domain vr-storyteller.preview.emergentagent.com before navigating — OAuth UI flow cannot be automated.
